InputShaper.AbortDescription: Shake&Tune can't be interrupted gracefully, so this triggers an emergency stop. Afterwards Klipper needs a firmware restart and the printer has to be homed again. Runs still waiting in the queue are cancelled too.
InputShaper.GraphDeleted: Graph removed by Shake&Tune's result retention
InputShaper.KlipperStoppedAlert: Klipper is shut down. Restart the firmware to continue.
InputShaper.LostTrack: A run doesn't seem to be making progress anymore, for example because Klipper restarted while this page was closed.
InputShaper.LowVibrationsAlternative: {axis}: for the lowest vibrations Shake&Tune suggests {shaper} instead, at the cost of more smoothing.

belts.Description: Compares the response of both belt paths. Matching curves mean evenly tensioned belts.
belts.Title: Belts comparison

vibrations.Description: Speeds and angles with the least vibrations, useful for slicer speeds and TMC tuning.
vibrations.Title: Vibrations profile

InputShaper.NoCompleteResults: There are no complete results for this run yet, so it's probably still running. Use Discard if you know it stopped.
InputShaper.NoRecommendationRecorded: This run wasn't started from this screen, so no recommendation was recorded. Read the values from the graphs and enter them below.
InputShaper.NoResultFiles: Shake&Tune didn't write any new graphs.
InputShaper.NothingToSave: The config already contains these values.
InputShaper.NoValues: No input shaper values in the config yet.
InputShaper.Queued: Queued, waiting for the other tools
InputShaper.RestartAfterPrint: The new values are used after the next firmware restart, which can't be done while printing.
InputShaper.ResultsOutsideConfig: Shake&Tune's result_folder is outside the config folder, so its results can't be shown here.
InputShaper.RetentionHint: Shake&Tune keeps only {count} results in total, so older graphs of a tool are deleted quickly. Consider raising number_of_results_to_keep in [shaketune]. The recommended values stay available here.
InputShaper.RunDescription: The printer will move and make noise for about {minutes} minutes. Keep the build area clear.
InputShaper.RunDescriptionAll: The printer will calibrate {count} tools one after another, about {minutes} minutes in total. Once started it can only be stopped with an emergency stop.
InputShaper.RunDescriptionTool: The printer will pick up {tool}, move and make noise for about {minutes} minutes. Keep the build area clear.
InputShaper.SavedDescription: {file} was updated. Klipper reads the new values after a firmware restart.
InputShaper.SavedPendingRestart: Saved to {file}. Restart the firmware to use the new values.
InputShaper.SectionNotFound: Couldn't find [{section}] in printer.cfg or its includes.
InputShaper.Title: Input Shaper
InputShaper.TryNowOnlyActive: Only possible while {name} is the active tool. Values stay active until the next tool change.
InputShaper.UnassignedDescription: Shake&Tune doesn't record which tool a result belongs to. Assign earlier results to a tool to see them in its history.
